issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. The change only adds an optional Lennard-Jones-style repulsion to the _relax initialiser, and SLSQP still computes the final packing. Validity is checked by the harness with zero tolerance.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. In LJ mode the (2RR/d)^6 force can be very large at short distances, but disp is clipped to ±0.02 per step and the positions are still clipped by R. This can only make the starting point worse; it cannot make the final packing invalid.

The new path only runs when seed % 2 == 1. If train.py uses one fixed even seed, the candidate does exactly what the incumbent does and the identical score is expected. If it uses multiple seeds, only the odd ones are affected. This is not visible in the diff and is worth checking.

The numbers support the decision. Candidate -2.636 vs incumbent -2.6360 is a difference of 0, so z = 0 and reject is correct. With n = 1 on each side the variance cannot be estimated from these data, but the difference is zero either way. -2.636 is about the known optimum (~2.6359) rounded, so it is plausible and does not beat the best known result.
